ruleDefinitions.name: Remote Service Activity via SVCCTL Named Pipe
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects remote service activity via remote access to the svcctl named pipe Note: Unmapped fields: ShareName, RelativeTargetName, AccessList

sequences.query: (event_id = 5145 AND ShareName = "\\\\\*\\IPC\$" AND RelativeTargetName = "svcctl" AND AccessList = RGX(".*WriteData.*"))
